title: Owlshift ticket plan
description:
A ticket's plan, in [`PLAN_FILE`](crate::refs::PLAN_FILE): the latest
plan of its design runs, the text and the base commit it was written on,
and the decider's approval once given.

base.description: The base commit the plan was written on, a full commit id.

format.description: The format version of this document.

text_sha256.description:
The SHA-256 of the ticket's title, a NUL byte and its description,
as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits, as `intake.json` keeps it.

Alternative.description: An approach the plan set aside.

Fork.description: A fork of the plan: its choice, the options it chose among, and why.

KeptApproval.description: The decider's approval of a plan.

comment.description:
The tracker's identifier of the comment that approved it: the
decider's, or, when the resolver decided the approval (OWL-343), its
DECISION comment, kept with the decision in `questions.json`.

plan_sha256.description:
The SHA-256 of the approved plan's [`Plan::canonical`] text, as 64
lowercase hexadecimal digits: a Build runs only on a plan with this
hash when approval is required (OWL-32).

Plan.description:
The plan a design run returns (architecture section 5, "Design"): what
the Build follows and the reviewers read. Every text is not blank.

alternatives.description: The approaches set aside, each with why.

criteria.description: The success criteria, taken from the ticket.

files.description: The files the work touches, from the repository's root.

forks.description:
The choices of how the design made between approaches that would
each deliver the ticket; `on-fork` plan approval reads them.

steps.description: The ordered steps, each with its test.

test.description: The test that shows the step done.
